Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.edit

Record Class EditRotationDeformerData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.edit.EditRotationDeformerData
All Implemented Interfaces:
EditObjectData
@Incubating @CubismEditor(from="5.1.02", to="5.3.99") public record EditRotationDeformerData(String name, Optional<PartId> parentId, Optional<DeformerId> parentDeformerId, double angle, double baseAngle, double scale, double opacity, Optional<String> multiplyColor, Optional<String> screenColor, EditLabelColor labelColor, Point2 position) extends Record implements EditObjectData
Read payload of a EditObjectKind.ROTATION_DEFORMER object, matching the official RotationDeformer data block of GetObject (external API 1.1.0). The official block reports a single Position{X,Y} pivot — it does not return a vertex list.
